title: Calculate the average number of posts created by users who are located in I
question: Calculate the average number of posts created by users who are located in India, have received the “Teacher” badge, and have a reputation higher than the average reputation of all users with the “Teacher” badge. The result should be rounded to one decimal place.

prediction.sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(pc.post_count), 1) AS avg_posts
FROM (
  SELECT u.XCL_052, COUNT(p.XCL_026) AS post_count
  FROM users u
  INNER JOIN badges b ON u.XCL_052 = b.XCL_002
  INNER JOIN posts p ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033
  WHERE u.XCL_058 = 'India'
    AND b.XCL_003 = 'Teacher'
    AND u.XCL_053 > (
      SELECT AVG(u2.XCL_053)
      FROM users u2
      INNER JOIN badges b2 ON u2.XCL_052 = b2.XCL_002
      WHERE b2.XCL_003 = 'Teacher'
    )
  GROUP BY u.XCL_052
) AS pc
